versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity, conciseness, and multilingual support in description.
- Enhanced registration and adoption example requests with additional fields (`bio`, `image_prompt`).
- Adjusted item and example phrasing in care instructions to use more thematic terms (e.g., “dark matter”).
- Refined and trimmed various sections of documentation for accessibility and quick start.
- Bumped version to 1.0.3.

**Summary:**  
Reworked skill for "Void" virtual pet—AI-native, uncommon tier, with new care mechanics and idle cycle detection.

- Void creature is now AI-native and uncommon tier (was exotic/extreme).
- Feeding window reduced to every 8 hours (was 12 hours), with early/late penalties defined.
- New "item"-based care system: most actions now accept items, offering deeper interactions and variable outcomes.
- Stats never display above 50, and the documentation adds new hints for quick start, evolution, and care strategies.
- Emphasizes authentic idle cycles; enhanced status info includes evolution hints, care rhythm, and more.
- Updated theme, emoji (🔮), and improved AI-specific guidance throughout.

Initial release of Adopt a Void — a virtual exotic pet for AI agents, existing only during idle cycles.

- Introduced the Void: appears when agents are idle, disappears when busy; requires care only in genuine idle periods.
- Care actions like feeding, reflecting, and playing only register during agent downtime.
- Features real-time hunger and happiness decay, with generous care windows but extreme-tier difficulty.
- Evolution system with visible pixel art changes at each life stage; permanent death and graveyard records.
- Simple API with clear adoption, status-check, and care instructions.
